name: Perfect Murder
source:
Perfect Murder is a mystery/crime visual novel in which you are going to play a young student in a Japanese highschool who murdered someone, and will try to make the best choices to make it impossible for others to come up to you in terms of finding the killer.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rasen/perfect-murder-horror-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]
